# Ocean Wave Theme / 大海海浪主题
Animated ocean waves with a whale swimming behind the page, plus translucent surfaces — a theme plug
in for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web.
整个应用背景铺设动态海浪特效，一条鲸鱼在页面后面游泳，界面各层变为半透明——适用于 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）web 端的主题插件。
## Features / 功能
- Four canvas wave bands with foam crests, sun/moon glow and twinkling sparkles. / 四层 canvas 波浪＋浪花边、

太阳/月亮光晕与闪烁波光。
- A whale that swims left → right every 28 seconds, riding the mid wave crest with wak

e trail, paddling fins and rising bubbles. / 一条鲸鱼每 28 秒自左向右游过，骑在中间波峰上，带尾迹、摆动鳍与上升气泡。
- Translucent li
ght/dark surfaces via design-token overrides, so the ocean shows through sidebars and panels. / 明暗两套

半透明 token，侧栏与面板透出海浪。
- Follows the app color scheme (`data-ds-dark-theme`), pauses when the tab is h
idden, and renders a still frame under `prefers-reduced-motion`. / 跟随应用明暗切换；标签页隐藏时暂停；`prefers-reduce
a still frame under `prefers-reduced-motion`. / 跟随应用明暗切换；标签页隐藏时暂停；`prefers-reduced-motion` 下只渲染静态帧。
## Install / 安装
From the dsh-market **Themes** tab (one click), or via CLI / 从 dsh-market 的**主题** Tab 一键安装，或命令行：
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The theme applies immediately and can be switched/uninstalled like any other theme. / 主题即时生效，可像其他主题一
me applies immediately and can be switched/uninstalled like any other theme. / 主题即时生效，可像其他主题一样切换与卸载。
## Layout / 结构
| File | Role |

| `index.js` | Host half (no-op; all rendering lives in the client). |
| `client.js` | Client half:

canvas backdrop + token overrides. |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Bundle patch inserting the plugin row. |

| `locale/en.json`, `locale/zh.json` | Bilingual title/description. |
| `assets/screenshot-*.png` |
Storefront screenshots (declared in `screenshots.json`). |
## Compatibility / 兼容性

- dsh web only (`dsh.client.platform: web`). / 仅 dsh web 端。
- No dependencies, no network calls, no
build step. / 零依赖、无网络请求、无需构建。

MIT — see LICENSE.
